jobs_results.title: Manager Project Management Office for Capacity Expansion / Senior...
jobs_results.description:
Description

We are seeking a seasoned and strategic Senior Manager (f/m/d) to lead our Project Management Office (PMO). In this role, you will oversee the successful execution of all capacity expansion projects in Power Transformers Europe, ensuring alignment with company goals, timelines, and budgetary constraints. You will be instrumental in driving efficiency, standardization, and best practices across the different projects.

Do you want to help shape the future with us in a continuously evolving environment? Then apply now, we are looking forward to you!

Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Your responsibilities
• Managing the Program Management Office for our expansion Projects
• Leading and motivating a project team, creating, and safeguarding the governance
• Close cooperation and coordination with internal and external stakeholders in your role as... key contact person in the projects
• Being the first contact person for the senior management and coordinating the steering committees
• Track and control project progress
• Monitor and control project financing, overseeing the status of billing, costs, cash flows and other performance metrics
• Opportunities - risk management and claim management with respect to contract and process-related disruptive events
• Initiate sustainable process improvements

Your background
• Successful degree in civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or comparable (Master / Dipl.)
• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in project management or project execution as well as technical leadership of international project teams
• Profound knowledge of senior management communication
• Advanced knowledge in MS Project
• Certification / advanced training as Senior Project Manager / PMP advantageous
• Very good communication skills, strong target orientation as well as structured working style and ability to work in a team
• Intercultural competence and consistent pursuit of set goals as well as assertiveness
• Fluent in written and spoken English and any other language.
• Willingness to travel on business of approx. 40%

Why join us?
• You will do interesting and enriching work, as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team which is committed to innovation, continuous improvement
• You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities
• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought
• Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be’ and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all
• Flexible working, including hybrid/remote working opportunities
• A competitive compensation and benefits package

jobs_results.title: API Technical  Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
AXA Group Operations is the IT solutions and business consulting provider of the AXA Group, one of the world's leading insurance and financial protection companies. We develop and operate transverse business solutions at international scale.

Working for the different companies of the AXA group, AXA Services has a worldwide action field with offices in 16 countries.

Our mission is to shape, build and maintain the shared solutions of AXA Group. The aim of these services is to sustain business development, reduce time to market, & generate savings.

Environment:

This resource will join a team of IT professionals involved in solution delivery and maintenance activities delivered by the API Management applicative team for the AXA Group.

Main tasks and responsibilities

· Do the scoping and manage technical projects (planning, workload, risks)

· Design APIs and provide high level support during UAT to the team (support user during their tests), ncluding defect management processes,

·... Ensure defined process is respected (change, defect, management).

· Deliver project documentation

· Develop APIs on webMethods when needed

· Review, check the quality and test APIs provided by developers

· Lead a small team (<5 persons)

· Manage Applicaitve BAU, Provide symptom check, critical situation analysis, recovery planning and implementation

· Single Point Of Contact for our client to adress all other teams (Platform, Operations) or sub product (moniotring, network, etc)

· Onboarding of junior members

· Ability to provide low level transversal knowledge between projects belonging to different companies inside our Group to increase the quality

Your Profile

Professional and technical skills

Technical Skills:

Experience: 3 to 5 years experience as Software AG/ web Methods developer and a first experience as project management

Must Have:

· First experience in technical project management to implement APIs using a Middleware

· REST and SOAP

· Knowledge on API gateways

Nice to Have:
• Broadcom Layer 7 experience
• webMethods experience
• Java development
• ELK knowledge

· Ability to travel / ability to be relocated for short periods in other countries.

Non-Technical Skills:
• Experience working alongside internal and external providers in an international context;
• Be required to work in professional cross teams environments, and at times, work autonomously;
• Communicating clearly, politely and respectfully in person, by telephone and in writing
• Explaining complex technical information simply
• Bringing people into conversations to ensure the right people are involved
• Knowing how to adapt to different people
• Degree in a relevant area, such as, Computer Science or similar education;
• Availability to work out of regular working hours if ocasionaly required;

Nice to have: Agility

Language

English: Independent user (C1 in Common European Framework of Reference for Languages)

Spanish: Independent user – it’s a plus

Portuguese: Independent user – it’s a plus

French: Independent user – it’s a plus

About AXA

As a world-leading insurance company, we act for human progress by protecting what matters. With 153,000 employees in 54 countries working with 105 million customers, we’ve created a truly dynamic and vibrant community. Inclusion and diversity link closely with our values, and together we’re nurturing a culture of
respect, for each other, for our customers and the communities around us. Join AXA and you’ll feel like you belong, are included and can thrive. You’ll be able to shape the way you work and truly grow your potential as you seek out new opportunities, push boundaries and benefit people in critical moments of their lives. This is your chance to build the tomorrow you want. Know you can.

About the Entity

AXA is becoming a sustainable tech-led company and at AXA Group Operations we are one of the major catalysts for this transformation.

We set the tone by triggering and empowering the evolution of our insurance business model through technology and innovation, driving its concrete implementation globally at speed, with a high quality of advisory and execution.

We are present across 17 countries with committed, highly qualified teams. We leverage technology, data, sourcing, security and investment allocation in a global way, but also achieve economies of scale and synergies when necessary.

At AXA Group Operations, we want to be recognized in three fields of action:
• State-of-the-art Data Technology to drive customer experience
• State-of-the-art Procurement & Sourcing to drive efficiency and better manage risks
• High-Performing Global Team for stronger partnerships with AXA entities

What We Offer

We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager EMEA PMO
jobs_results.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As a PMO (Project Management Office) Senior Project Manager, you will support the EMEA Life-Cycle Services (EMEA LCS) PMO office objectives and the EMEA LCS Project Management community.

This role is designed to ensure that the EMEA LCS Project Management community has full PMO support and... control that ensures LCS PMs have the tools and training to plan, control, and manage project deliverables that meet the strategic framework business objectives and global standards.

You will help to support and provide guidance and control around EMEA LCS project management processes and delivery methodologies and ensure compliance and governance around these processes.

You will report to the EMEA LCS Regional PMO Manager, providing support anywhere in the EMEA region. This role can performed as remote position in EMEA.

Your Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with the business unit(s) and support departments such as project administration, Engineering, Finance, Manufacturing (ISC) etc. to ensure all partners are informed and to support project management delivery mechanisms and requirements.
• Engage in critical projects and reviews with their supporting PMs to ensure margins are maintained or improved.
• Support LCS project reviews providing mitigation guidance to help ensure complete project success. This requires complete understanding of BU objectives.
• Support project health and portfolio risk, where opportunity is identified, assessed, and managed amongst the team.
• Frequently consult on projects led by others providing input on high-level delivery issues.
• Provide support on the PM Associates program and project management certification processes.
• Suggest and review updates with affected stakeholders on integrated project management delivery documents and templates for the QMS library (processes and procedures).
• Responsible for process improvement activities within assigned business role.
• Develop and communicate program/project information for LSC and business senior management in scheduled and ad-hoc meetings.
• Communicate effectively, both verbally and in written form, to a broad audience of varying technical and cultural backgrounds.
• Provide executive-level reports and support of readouts / action items to leadership.
• Onboarding of new PM's and supporting any training activities and monitoring required to ensure successful integration of PMs into the delivery teams.

The Essentials - You Will Have:
• Bachelors degree as a minimum
• Legal authorization to work in EMEA. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
• The ability to travel 10% of the time.
• 20+ years of professional experience with 15+ years experience in project management
• PMP certification
• Ability to lead, influence, motivate and resolve conflict within a team environment to meet program goals efficiently.
• Independently manage the coordination of activities and held responsible for results.
• Make high pressure decisions with the information available.
• Strong negotiator
• Interact effectively with many personalities and social styles.
• Maintains composure in challenging situations, ensuring continued effectiveness in performing tasks.
• Represent large matrixed organization in business strategy activities.
• Technical expertise in automation controls, possessing an understanding of processes and batch control systems

jobs_results.title: Project Manager Specialist
jobs_results.description:
The future is what we make it.

When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers and doers who make the things that make the future. That means changing the way we fly, fueling jets in an eco-friendly way, keeping buildings smart and safe and even making it possible to breathe on Mars.

Working at Honeywell isn’t just about developing cool things. That’s why all our employees enjoy access to dynamic career opportunities across different fields and industries.

Are you ready to help us make the future?

We are currently looking for a Project Manager Specialist to join Industry Automation our team! The purpose of this position is to execute Control and Automation projects in PAS Southern Europe region and based in Spain to deliver best in class solutions in accordance with company procedures and in support of the overall objectives of Project Operations to meet customer expectations and within estimated financial performance. Lead the... skills development, information sharing and project management discipline necessary to the deliver Projects in a timely manner at planned gross margins or higher in the region. The candidate shall be able to establish the proper execution model even during proposal and execution phase to achieve continuous margin improvement, customer satisfaction, schedule, working capital and safety performance.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Overall responsibility for managing Projects in Southern region from opportunity development stage to delivering the project successfully to customer.

· Ensures on time delivery of projects, within scope with zero or positive deviation.

· Establish professional relationships and communications with key customers to ensure potential customer satisfaction issues are recognized and addressed in a timely manner.

· Ensure that the baseline project documents including the contract, planning, cost estimate, project execution plan (including human resource plan and working schedule), project organization description, communications protocols, QA practices etc. are produced, maintained, followed and made available to all concerned.

· Establish and execute detailed plans to ensure that risks are mitigated, and opportunities are realized that may impact the objectives of assigned projects and/or organization

· Ownership for Projects financial performance. Monitors financial performance monthly and reviews estimates versus actuals to continuously improve Projects operational metrics. (EAC, Billings, cost budgets, milestone payments, rebates, warranty)

· Accurately report the status (resources, technical issues, customer satisfaction) of assigned projects on all key metrics

· Responsible for estimating and negotiations of contract / scope variations (including change orders).

· Effectively leads the implementation of productivity enhancing process changes related to project delivery.

· Responsible for driving costs down to be competitive in the marketplace.

· Ensures the availability of tools, equipment, and materials required while maintaining and controlling inventory levels. Ensures projects are resourced properly.

· Participate in estimate review process prior to jobs being quoted to ensure labor estimates are correct and that the work is achievable from a technical perspective. Ensure that subcontracts, where applicable, are complete and documented.

· Participate in material SIOP call with factory planners to provide forecast for Backlog and Front log project order demand to factory

· Work closely with LSS (Lifecycle Solutions & Services) organizations to ensure that projects are properly closed out and that maintenance and support opportunities are maximized

· Participate jointly with the P&E (Proposal and Estimate) team to develop and have high level >75% of winning of new opportunities, identifying the correct cost and execution model.

REQUIREMENTS:

· BS degree or equivalent technical or management experience, minimum 5 years of experience required.

· Thorough knowledge of handling Projects Operations and financial processes.

· The ability to demonstrate energy and determination to achieve results and improvement by overcoming obstacles, remaining effective despite setbacks, and challenging current thinking.

· The ability to engage employees by providing relevant information in a timely manner using clear and compelling messages and by listening to and valuing input from employees.

· The ability to understand the implications and assess the appropriate degree of acceptable risk and take actions to minimize risk.

· Excellent in MS Office mainly word, excel, access, Project.

· Language: Spanish, Portuguese preferred, English good level capable of keep contractual conversation.

WE OFFER:

· A challenging international work environment.

· A competitive salary package with a variety of fringe benefits.

· Career development possibilities.

If this is your dream role, then we'd love to hear from you!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
Additional Information
• JOB ID: HRD221324
• Category: Business Management
• Relocation Tier: Not Applicable
• Security Clearance:
• Aviation Authority (FAA for US):
• Band: 03
• Referral Bonus: 1000
• Requisition Type: Standard Requisition
• US Citizenship:
• FLSA Statement:
• FLSA CODE: Exempt

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Our culture believes in Powering Your Potential. We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what #LifeAtCummins is all about.

Project Manager

Description

We are selecting a Project Manager for Cummins Spain, San Fernando de Henares.

Hybrid work model, travelling 60%, relocation is not eligible .

English high level (C1 Cambridge equivalent) is a MUST.

In this role, you will make an impact in some of the following ways:
• Identifying project stakeholders, risks, work scope, budget and schedule expectations
• Developing Project Plans
• Reporting to both internal and external stakeholders, including Company Leaders, the status of his/her projects: time schedule, costs vs. Budget, risks, technical issues... etc
• Coordinating with subject matter experts to ensure that the project execution plan has correctly identified the required resources, tools, and methodology.
• Understanding project activities and interdependencies in order to support the development of an accurate budget and schedule, then managing project execution accordingly.
• Understanding contractual terms and conditions
• Serving as the primary client interface
• Supporting the establishment of effective working relationships, both within the project team and between the project team and external stakeholders. Measuring project performance, forecasting outcomes and, when necessary, developing proactive course corrections
• Ensuring that the project team is adhering to applicable Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) and Quality Management, and Projects Systems
• From the sales process, identifying and register the Projects’ risks, monitoring these risks while using creativity and out-of-the-box thinking to propose mitigation

To be successful in this role you will need the following:
• Engineering College, University, or equivalent degree required
• Electrical or Mechanical background preferably
• Relevant work experience in Engineering Project Management (2 to 4 years minimum)
• Very high level of Spanish & English language : written and oral communications (minimum level C1 equivalent)
• Main skills/competences: Excellent Communication skills, Team oriented, Solution driven.
• Availability to travel (60%)

Job SALES

Primary Location Spain-Community of Madrid-Madrid-Spain, San Fernando de Henares, Cummins Spain DBU

Job Description & Summary

Overview

We’re looking for an IT Project Manager who would be responsible for managing and delivering our internal IT projects within the CEE region in a fast paced and evolving technology environment.

He/she will also be part of our Project Management Office helping us govern the projects portfolio and our less-experienced colleagues manage their projects successfully.

The ideal candidate will have at least three years experience in IT project management, managing multiple technology-related projects concurrently for various customers and being able to switch the subjects quickly while keeping the deliverables on track.

Our focus is to find a self-organized and proactive individual with a passion for technology and a strong desire to drive value delivery and continuous improvement.

This position is available in remote mode with occasional travel to the office based on the project... needs.

Key responsibilities:

Project Management (80% FTE)
• Manage and coordinate internal IT projects in the CEE region, including infrastructure implementations, software development, and automations.
• Ensure overall ownership and accountability of end-to-end project delivery and management, from project initiation to closure.
• Utilize standard best practices in project management with a focus on value delivery and continuous improvement.

Project Management Office Governance (20% FTE):
• Assist with governance of the CEE IT Projects portfolio, maintain up-to-date information, define standards and provide training.
• Ensure compliance with PMO standards and best practices by IT Project Managers.
• Proactively identify and resolve issues and seize opportunities to improve our operations.
• Provide valuable insights for the leadership.

PM Experience
• 3-5 years in IT Project Management
• Management and ownership of entire project lifecycle
• Preferred experience with infrastructure implementations, data migrations, automations
• Project management certification welcome (PMI/Prince)

IT Skills
• General IT background with passion for new technologies and ability to rapidly acquire knowledge and proficiency in new areas
• Familiarity with industry-standard IT corporate solutions.

Personal skills
• Self-organized person with passion for technology and drive to get things done
• Mature with low level of supervision needed
• Able to work under pressure and tight deadlines
• Proactive, agile and value-driven
• Ability to multitask and prioritize

Language:
• English - required

Travel:
• 0-25% within CEE

jobs_results.title: Project Manager Electronic Payment Methods
jobs_results.description:
The future is our choice

At Atos, as the global leader in secure and decarbonized digital, our purpose is to help design the future of the information space. Together we bring the diversity of our people’s skills and backgrounds to make the right choices with our clients, for our company and for our own futures.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Project Manager to lead our Electronic Payment Methods team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electronic payments, including familiarity with various payment platforms, technologies, and regulatory requirements. As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of electronic payment solutions to meet the needs of our organization and our customers.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead and manage the Electronic Payment Methods team, including project planning, resource allocation, and performance management.
• Develop and implement strategic plans for... electronic payment initiatives, in alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product development, engineering, finance, and compliance, to define requirements and deliver solutions on time and within budget.
• Identify and mitigate risks associated with electronic payment projects, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and best practices.
• Monitor and evaluate the performance of electronic payment systems, analyzing data and metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Stay current with industry trends and developments in electronic payments, incorporating new technologies and innovations into our payment ecosystem.
• Serve as a subject matter expert on electronic payment methods, providing guidance and support to internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the Electronic Payment Methods team.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of experience in project management, with a focus on electronic payments or financial technology.
• Proven track record of successfully leading complex projects from conception to implementation, preferably in the electronic payments industry.
• Strong understanding of electronic payment technologies, including but not limited to EMV, NFC, QR codes, mobile wallets, and blockchain.
• Familiarity with regulatory requirements and compliance standards related to electronic payments, such as PCI DSS and PSD2.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
• PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification is a plus.
• Experience with Agile or Scrum methodologies is desirable.

Teleworking: Initially 100% in-person the first months and then hybrid modality.

After 3 months, the candidate would become part of the Workplace client's staff.

Work Address: Barcelona

Working time: 8-hour shift adapted to the client in the Banking Sector

If you are passionate about electronic payments and possess the skills and experience required for this role, we encourage you to apply and join our dynamic team!

How to Apply: Please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your relevant experience to gergana.panicharova@atos.net

Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.

Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.

jobs_results.title: SAP Testing Senior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a SAP Testing Senior Project Manager to be part of our IT Platforms Department.

Position Snapshot
• Location: Nestlé Global Tech Hub in Barcelona, Spain
• Type of Contract: Permanent
• Stream: IT Platforms
• Type of work: Hybrid
• Work Language: Fluent Business English
• Grade: G1

The role

In this position, you will bring deep expertise and knowledge to the SAP Landscape platform group team. As an SAP Testing Senior Project Manager, you will be responsible for guiding and promoting the proper testing framework & tools amongst the regional testing leads, coaching and supporting functional experts in the testing of the S/4HANA program and other technical projects.

You will work closely with the SAP Landscape team and suppliers to ensure that the manual regression testing milestones are achieved in time and with the quality standards agreed. Also, you will be responsible for supervising the testing framework and tools as well as the implementation within the scope... agreed, owning the overall testing strategy and governance.

What you’ll do

• Make recommendations on how to improve the effectiveness, efficiency, and delivery of testing services through use of (emerging) technology and technical methods and methodologies.

• Drive S/4 HANA technical projects, leading the testing teams.

• Participate in the development of and/or review of S/4 HANA testing strategy, documentation, and methods.

• Liaise closely with vendors for proof of concepts of new tools available in the market related to manual and automated testing.

• Work with IS/IT Innovation managers, Platform managers, Product Stream Operations Managers and Business Analysts as required to ensure S/4 HANA testing can be covered.

We offer you

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
• Great benefits including competitive salary and a comprehensive social benefits package. We have one of the most competitive pension plans on the market, as well as flexible remuneration with tax advantages: health insurance, restaurant card, mobility plan, etc.
• Personal and professional growth through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
• Hybrid working environment with flexible working scheme. Our state-of-the-art campus is dog friendly and equipped with a medical center, canteen and areas to co-create network and chill!
• Recreation activities such as yoga, Zumba, etc. and a wide range of volunteering activities.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, system analysis or a related study, or equivalent experience

• Strong stakeholder management

• 10+ years in IT field, focusing on S/4 HANA projects, including experience in SAP testing, and managing testing tools such as Solution Manager and Azure DevOps.

• Good understanding of test automation platforms.

• Strong background in SAP project management

• Thorough understanding of software development lifecycle, specifically automated quality assurance processes

Bonus points if you:

• Have excellent analytical and technical skills.

• Have experience with effective communication at different levels in the organization and in English.

• Have experience working in a global environment and with virtual teams.

About the IT Hub

At Nestlé IT, we are a diverse, global team of IT professionals in the biggest health, nutrition and wellness company of the world. We strive to create an environment where people are valued for who they are. We innovate every day through future ready technologies to create opportunities for Nestlé to delight consumers, customers and employees alike. We collaborate with partners around the world to deliver tangible value at global scale. We continuously work to develop our people to be future ready.

About Nestlé

We are Nestlé, the largest food and beverage company in the world, with a presence in more than 185 countries. With net sales of CHF 94.4 billion in 2022, the company has over 291,000 employees and 418 factories in 85 countries. Our values are based on respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity, and respect for our future. Nestlé is dedicated to offering high-quality food and beverage products and services that contribute to the nutrition, health, and well-being of people, pets, and the planet. Additionally, it is committed to being a leading company in sustainability and achieving net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Want to learn more? Visit us at: www.nestle.com

We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.

Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

Join Nestlé’s IT Hub #beaforceforgood

How we will proceed: You send us your CV → We contact relevant applicants → Interviews → Feedback → Job Offer communication to the Finalist → First working day
